Name: Nuclear Valley - PG
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=6][center]About:[/center][/size][/color][size=3][color=#f4f4f4]This mod adds Nuclear Bombs, Industrial and Military buildings, a marriage NPC, Marisol, a not-marriage NPC, Anabelle, and also, some groovy areas, such as Clairabelle Lagoon, Mermaid Dugout Bunker, Nuclear Sub Pen, Nuclear Submarine, Atarra Mountain Top (Submerged Level!), and Sunken Ghost Pirate Ship. Also adds new clothing and furniture, and new food items!

This is the PG version. There may come an R-Rated version at some juncture which is in the future.
  [/color][/size][center][color=#ffff00][size=6]Instructions to Make a Nuke:[/size][/color][/center]
Once you have unlocked the minecarts, take the minecart (For Free!) to Clairabelle Lagoon. Anabelle's Shop will allow you to build the Building you need to be able to produce Nuclear Bombs.


[size=6][center][color=#ffff00]Steps for Building Nuclear Bomb:[/color][/center][/size]1. Build an Atomic Science Silo. 
2. Add 2 Radioactive Ores to the first machine on the left inside the back room in the Atomic Science Silo, the Uranium Purifier, producing 1 Unrefined Plutonium.
3. Place 1 Unrefined Plutonium into Plutonium Refiner, producing 1 Refined Plutonium.
4. Placed 2 Refined Plutonium and 1 Iron Bar into the Doom Maker to make 1 Nuclear Bomb.

[color=#ffff00][size=6][center]Instructions to Use a Nuke:[/center]
[/size][/color][size=3]Use like any bomb! But Run. You have eleven seconds. You will definitely die otherwise if you do not run out of the clast radius of 137 tiles. Usually, this is another screen away. A Phoenix Ring is very useful here. (Jean Grey's Dark Phoenix powers would be useful here!). Mostly, though, run very fast. Will blow up anything, except shrubberies. Will take down trees, stumps, rocks. Will kill enemies. Has two blasts, will kill all the zombies and mummified ones. Running is smart. Use a speed drink or something, or eat one of Marisol's Granola Bars, or you are to become toast.[/size]

[size=6][center][color=#ffff00]Buildings:[/color][/center][/size][size=5]Atomic Science Silo[/size]
[size=3][left]Enables building Nuclear Bombs.[/left][/size][size=5]Advanced Atomic Science Silo[/size]
[size=3][left]Enables more efficient production of Nuclear Bombs.[/left][/size]
[size=5]Mushroom Bunker[/size][size=3][left]Has 12 mushroom boxes.[/left][/size] 
[size=5]Shipping Container Shed[/size][left]Has space for 115 kegs set up in a perfect loop.[/left]
[size=5]Quonset Hut
[/size]Has space for 1039 kegs in a perfect looping setup. That's a lot of kegs, Jaquelline!
